sells.reason: Bought 2026-06-10 specifically for the FDA RMAT designation on Cellectis's off-the-shelf allogeneic leukemia CAR-T. On 2026-09-11/09-14 the company announced a strategic transformation that EXITS ex-vivo CAR-T entirely -- dropping lasme-cel and eti-cel (the NATHALI-01/BALLI-01 programs, the exact RMAT-designated candidates this position was bought for) -- and pivots to an unrelated preclinical in-vivo gene editing platform (.HEAL-101, .HEAL-201) targeting chronic metabolic disease, with first data not expected until H2 2027 / H1 2028. Stock dropped on the news. The catalyst this thesis was built on no longer exists at the company; a 1.5-2 year preclinical restart is not the story that was bought. Not urgent (disclosed pivot, market already repriced it, no fraud/halt confirmed -- a plaintiffs'-firm 'investigation' notice exists but that's routine solicitation, not a finding).

Vertical Aerospace's Valo/VX4 certification timeline has slipped from ~2026 (at entry) to 2028 to now 2029 (confirmed 2026-07-12 6-K) -- a 3-year push-out that guts the near-term catalyst this quick-trade position was riding. Compounding distress signals: stock down ~88% over 12 months, employee stock options repriced down to $1.30 (Sept 11 AGM), and expanded consent/nomination rights granted to Mudrick Capital -- a distressed-capital investor. Stalled setup with no near-term follow-through, not a drawdown call. No new facts this run; carried forward.
